title: 24 July 2010: Paul McCartney live at Sprint Center, Kansas City, Missouri
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Sprint Center in Kansas City, Missouri, USA, on 24 July 2010.

It was the 16th concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011. This show was seen by 14,258 fans.

Here’s a clip of McCartney performing The Beatles’ 1968 song ‘Blackbird’ at the show:

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
